appearance_facts.fact: The largest pie slice is a reddish-orange wedge labeled 'Nuclear (45%)'.
The second-largest slice is a red wedge labeled 'Hydroelectric (30%)'.
Two smaller slices are present: a light orange wedge labeled 'Renewables (10%)' and a pale yellow wedge labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)'.
